turns.message: Is there a spend threshold for free shipping?

turns.message: I just placed an order and want to cancel it. How long do I have?
turns.reply: You can change or cancel an order yourself within 60 minutes of placing it [1]. Open Account, then Orders, and select Edit or Cancel [1]. After 60 minutes the order has usually gone to the warehouse and can no longer be changed; you can return the items once they arrive [1].

turns.message: Do you deliver to Canada, and how long does it take?

If it still has not appeared, report it within 14 days of the delivery date so we can file a claim [1].

turns.message: My tracking says delivered but there's nothing at my door. What should I do?

If it still has not appeared, report it within 14 days of the delivery date so we can file a claim [1].

turns.message: How much is gift wrap?
turns.reply: You can add gift wrapping for $4.95 per item at checkout and include a free gift message of up to 200 characters [1]. Packing slips for gift orders do not show prices [1].

turns.message: How do I start a return?
turns.reply: Open Account, then Orders, select the item and choose Return [1]. Print the prepaid label, pack the item, attach the label and drop the parcel at any carrier location [1]. You do not need to contact support to start a normal return [1].

turns.message: Do I have to pay to return an item that I simply don't want?
turns.reply: Gift cards, downloadable software, personalised or engraved items, and opened hygiene items such as ear tips cannot be returned [1]. Clearance items marked Final Sale cannot be returned unless they arrive faulty [1].

turns.message: How long until my refund shows up after you receive the return?
turns.reply: We inspect returns within 2 business days of arrival and then issue the refund to your original payment method [1]. Banks usually take 5 to 10 business days to show it [1]. Store credit is available immediately after inspection [1].

turns.message: Can I return a gift card?
turns.reply: Gift recipients can return an item with the order number from the packing slip [1]. The refund is issued as store credit to the recipient, and the buyer is not notified [1].

turns.message: The lamp arrived smashed. What's the deadline to report it?
turns.reply: If an item arrives damaged, report it within 7 days of delivery with a photo of the item and the packaging [1]. We will send a free replacement or give a full refund, your choice [1]. Keep the packaging until the claim is closed [1].

turns.message: How long is the warranty on your desks and chairs?
turns.reply: Fernwick-branded furniture has a 5 year warranty and Fernwick-branded electronics have a 2 year warranty against manufacturing defects [1]. Warranties do not cover accidental damage, normal wear or unauthorised repairs [1]. Other brands are covered by their maker's warranty [1].

turns.message: Which payment methods do you take?
turns.reply: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal and Fernwick gift cards [1]. We do not accept personal checks, cash on delivery or cryptocurrency [1].

turns.message: When will my card actually be charged?
turns.reply: Your card is authorised when you place the order and charged when the order ships [1]. A pending authorisation is not a charge and drops off your statement within 3 to 7 business days if the order is cancelled [1].

turns.message: How do I change the card on my account?
turns.reply: Go to Account, then Payment methods, and select Add card or Remove [1]. To change the card used for your Fernwick Plus renewal, set the new card as Default [1].

turns.message: Why was my payment declined?
turns.reply: Payments are usually declined because the billing address does not match the one held by the bank, the card has expired, or the bank has blocked the purchase [1]. Check the details, try another card or payment method, or ask your bank to approve the transaction [1].

turns.message: Do gift cards expire?
turns.reply: Enter the 16 digit gift card code at checkout [1]. Gift cards never expire and have no fees [1]. You can use up to 3 gift cards on one order [1].

turns.message: Can I use two promo codes on one order?
turns.reply: Only one promo code can be used per order, and codes cannot be added after the order has been placed [1]. Codes do not apply to gift cards or to Final Sale items [1].

turns.message: The price dropped a few days after I bought it. Can I get the difference?
turns.reply: If the price of an item drops within 14 days of your purchase, contact support and we refund the difference as store credit [1]. Price adjustments do not apply to clearance, lightning deals or other retailers' prices [1].

turns.message: I forgot my password, how long is the reset link good for?
turns.reply: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email address [1]. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes [1]. If no email arrives, check your spam folder and make sure you used the address on the account [1].

turns.message: My account got locked after a few wrong passwords. How long do I wait?
turns.reply: An account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed sign-in attempts [1]. Wait 15 minutes or reset your password to unlock it right away [1].

turns.message: How do I turn on two factor authentication?
turns.reply: Turn on two-step verification under Account, then Security [1]. You can use an authenticator app or text message codes [1]. Save the 10 recovery codes shown during setup, because each code works once if you lose your phone [1].

turns.message: What's the yearly price of Plus?
turns.reply: Fernwick Plus costs $49 per year or $5.99 per month [1].

turns.message: How do I cancel my Fernwick Plus membership?
turns.reply: Cancel any time under Account, then Membership, then Cancel [1]. Benefits continue until the end of the period you have paid for, and the membership does not renew [1].

turns.message: Is there a free trial for Plus and how long is it?
turns.reply: New members get a 30 day free trial [1]. We email a reminder 3 days before the trial ends [1]. Each household can use one trial [1].

turns.message: My standing desk shows E01 and won't move

turns.message: What's the maximum weight the Rise desk can hold?
turns.reply: The Rise standing desk supports up to 120 kg (265 lb) and adjusts from 72 cm to 120 cm in height [1]. The desktop measures 140 cm by 70 cm [1].

turns.message: Will the monitor arm hold a 32 inch screen? What's the biggest it takes?
turns.reply: The Perch monitor arm fits screens up to 34 inches and 9 kg (19.8 lb) with a VESA 75 x 75 mm or 100 x 100 mm mount [1]. It clamps to desktops between 1 cm and 6 cm thick [1].

turns.message: How do I pair the Quill keyboard with my laptop?
turns.reply: To pair the Quill wireless keyboard, switch it on, then hold Fn and 1, 2 or 3 for 3 seconds until the light blinks, and select Quill Keyboard in your device's Bluetooth settings [1]. It remembers up to 3 devices [1].

turns.message: people on calls can't hear me through the Murmur headset
